Ready for each committee

  1. Enter the committee’s actual MyAlert entity code and its QR destination.
  2. Check the code in both locations. Scan the generated QR with a phone to verify its destination.
  3. Download the PDF and ask the printer for 100% actual size, without “fit to page.” The PDF already has the selected physical dimensions.
  4. Review a proof before printing. The supplied original artwork is a raster image; the added code and QR stay sharp in PDF, but increasing page size cannot add detail to the background.

QR scanning and manual code search are alternative routes. This generator does not create an entity, verify that a code exists, or subscribe anyone automatically.
